question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Antagonist
solution:
The correct answer is** "Adversary."**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Antagonist"** means a person who actively opposes or is hostile to someone or something. (ऐसा व्यक्ति जो सक्रिय रूप से किसी व्यक्ति या वस्तु का विरोध या शत्रुतापूर्ण व्यवहार करता हो)

 
 
• **Example**: *The **antagonists**__ in this dispute are quite unwilling to compromise.*
 
 
 
• **"Adversary"** is a synonym of** "antagonist."**
 
• **"Adversary"** means an opponent or enemy. (शत्रु; किसी स्‍पर्धा में विरोधी पक्ष)
 __
 
• **Example**: *He saw her as his main **adversary**__ within the company.*
 
 
 
• The correct answer is Option 2.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **"Evil" (Option 1)** means morally wrong or wicked. (बुरा, दुष्‍ट, पापी; लोगों को दुखी करने वाला)
 
• **"Nerd" (Option 3)** refers to a person who is extremely interested in academic or intellectual pursuits. (पुरानी चाल का और उबाऊ शौक़ पालने वाला आदमी, खूसट आदमी)
 
• **"Amiable" (Option 4)** means friendly and pleasant. (मैत्रीपूर्ण और सुखद)
